 FOR SUBSCRIBERS 2026 Election Battleground state voters weigh who should oversee their elections
 In Arizona, Georgia, Michigan and Nevada, the winners of November’s secretary of state races will hold key election authority during the 2028 presidential contest. Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 Secretary of state races used to fly under the radar, but they have taken on greater national prominence in the Trump era.  Emily Elconin / Bloomberg via Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 20, 2026, 5:00 AM EDT  /  Updated   Oct. 20, 2026, 8:55 AM EDT By Jane C. Timm Voters in a handful of swing states will decide next month who will hold critical election oversight power during the next presidential contest.
